title: Where Are My Glasses?  (私の眼鏡はどこ？)

segments.t: 朝食前のフロントに、宿のオーナーであるアーサーが慌ただしくやって来ました。今日から四号室に一週間滞在する大切なお客さまが気にかかり、老眼鏡を探して大騒ぎしています。まずは英語のやり取りを聴いてみましょう。
Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Hannah. Is everything ready?
Good morning! Yes, the desk is clean and the keys are ready.
Today's guest in room four is staying all week. Everything must be perfect!
Relax, Arthur. The room is clean and the towels are fresh.
I need to read the reservation book, but I cannot find my glasses!
Are they in your coat pocket?
No, only my pen and three old receipts!
Look in the mirror behind the desk, boss.
Why would my glasses be in the... oh! They are on my head!
Right there on your forehead, safe and sound.
Do not tell anyone! Now, smile brightly when the bell rings.
Here comes a taxi at the gate right now.
それでは今の場面を、一文ずつ落ち着いて確かめていきましょう。
Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Hannah. Is everything ready?
'みんな、おはよう！ようこそ、ハンナ。準備はすべて整っているかい？'
Good morning! Yes, the desk is clean and the keys are ready.
'おはようございます！はい、フロントは清潔ですし、鍵の準備もできています。'
Today's guest in room four is staying all week. Everything must be perfect!
'今日の四号室のお客さまは一週間ずっと滞在される。すべて完璧でなくては！'
Relax, Arthur. The room is clean and the towels are fresh.
'落ち着いて、アーサー。部屋はきれいだし、タオルも洗い立てだよ。'
I need to read the reservation book, but I cannot find my glasses!
'予約台帳を読む必要があるのに、私の眼鏡が見つからないんだ！'
Are they in your coat pocket?
'コートのポケットの中に入っていませんか？'
No, only my pen and three old receipts!
'いや、私のペンと古いレシートが三枚あるだけだ！'
Look in the mirror behind the desk, boss.
'フロントの後ろの鏡を見てごらんよ、ボス。'
Why would my glasses be in the... oh! They are on my head!
'どうして私の眼鏡が鏡の中になんて…あっ！頭の上にあるじゃないか！'
Right there on your forehead, safe and sound.
'まさにおでこの上に、無事におさまっていますよ。'
Do not tell anyone! Now, smile brightly when the bell rings.
'誰にも言わないでくれよ！さあ、ベルが鳴ったら明るく微笑んで。'
Here comes a taxi at the gate right now.
'ほら、たった今、門のところにタクシーが来たよ。'
ではもう一度、場面全体を通して聴いてみましょう。

Relax, Arthur. The room is clean and the towels are fresh.
I need to read the reservation book, but I cannot find my glasses!
Are they in your coat pocket?
No, only my pen and three old receipts!
Look in the mirror behind the desk, boss.
Why would my glasses be in the... oh! They are on my head!
Right there on your forehead, safe and sound.
Do not tell anyone! Now, smile brightly when the bell rings.
Here comes a taxi at the gate right now.
おでこに載せたままの眼鏡も無事に見つかり、門の前にはちょうどタクシーが到着しました。大切な四号室のお客さまをこれからお迎えします。それではまた後ほど。
Bye for now!
